selfReview.method: Read full Japanese explanations/scenarios/dialogue, translated complete connected Khmer, and reviewed source roles/conditions/uncertainty/sequence/clinical recipients. semanticChecks: Review separates misunderstanding mechanisms, subject/time errors, overlooked conditions, inference beyond evidence and unclear communication. Correct-answer position memorization does not establish reasoning; choose one error from two submitted exercises, apply to new example and carry remaining work forward.30minutes is planned budget, not measured mastery time.

Transfer/hygiene skills needing hand position/force/coordination remain separate supervised practical assessment under individual plan/facility guidance. Reading sequence is not verified safe skill. Scores/one correction are not comprehensive care qualification, professional approval or official exam success.

Dish present on table is verified object state; person used dish/finished meal/help completed remain unknown. Towel prepared beside basin does not prove person face-washed; implementation checked separately with assigned staff. Fictional review sheet is not real examinee score.8:10comb dropped actor/user remains unknown; assigned staff will check, not already checked. No invented subject, blame or cause.

Emotion expression varies; facial expression is clue, not definitive feeling. Motivation supports meaningful personal goals/choice rather than replacing possible self-care. Physical/environmental/body/psychosocial stress factors all preserved. Noise complaint not dislike of social contact or blanket future refusal; person words/preferences checked, no personality blame.

Memory encoding/retention/retrieval, short/long-term, episodic/semantic/procedural and priming effects distinguished. Familiar scissors skill does not prove new schedule encoding/recall nor imply all memory preserved. Difficulty in one process not generalized to every skill; observed strengths/difficulties separately recorded and assessment sought.

Maslowfivephysiological/safety/belonging-love/esteem/self-actualization needs preserved, basic/social grouping not person-value hierarchy or strict sequential completion. Need for eating assistance does not eliminate social connection/choice; both supported.

Homeostasis retains regulated internal range, sweating heat loss, not fixed single number. Temperature daily/person variation and actual sleep/activity/health/baseline conditions retained. Axillary example tip placement/arm closure, unaffected side in hemiplegia, individual plan/device/training/no forced posture retained. Ear/forehead/axilla not identical method; record values/units/time/site/device/conditions; no invented unknown previous result.

Vital signs temperature/respiration/pulse/BP are information, not wholebody conclusion from one number. Airway nose/pharynx/larynx/trachea/bronchi and alveolarbloodgasexchange preserve oxygen in/carbon dioxide out. Breathing count/state/distress/sound/sputum/baseline all observed; cough/sputum protective function and reported changes not pathogen diagnosis.

Cyanosisbluepurplelips/nails may relate to oxygen deficiency but absent color change does not prove safety. New breathlessness promptly reaches explicit medical professionals; severe distress follows facility emergency procedure and immediate assistance. Do not wait for color or selfdiagnose emotion cause.

Pulse is heartbeat transmitted to arteries, assessed count/rhythm/strength with measuredtime/site/method/state. Radial/brachial/superficialtemporal/carotid/groin/dorsalfoot sites retained without permission for independent neck manipulation. Age/activity/tension/health/disease/medication/baseline conditions retained; child faster tendency not universal linear slowing. Medication conditions checked with explicit medical professionals. Generic normal impression does not replace measured results.
